verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete as an analysis-only change. The six-condition BAF statement excludes the identified variable-predicate and recursive compound-term counterexamples, and its finite active-domain/ground-head argument supports the stated termination and PTIME data-complexity bounds. The document consistently distinguishes termination from OSB cost, scopes arbitrary-rule nontermination to in-process callers today, marks ACP/ODRL as unaudited, labels the argument informal rather than machine-checked, and states that enforcement is not shipped. Its proposed rejection cases are non-vacuous checker targets, and the companion design accurately carries these caveats. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue is present. With no findings in either round 2 or round 3, progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
